display: Second-year nursing student in western Sydney who runs a small weekend cleaning team with two classmates around Parramatta and Auburn.

signals.text: I'm starting a three-week surgical ward placement at a hospital in Westmead on October 12, with 6:30 am starts, and I'm preparing for it.
I need a pair of comfortable, non-slip work shoes for long hospital shifts and I haven't found the right ones yet.
I'm looking for a reflective journal template or good examples for daily nursing placement notes. My supervisor wants a paper journal with dates and times.
My handwriting is messy, and I want to improve it before I have to chart and keep paper notes on placement.
I'm looking for a roommate in western Sydney, because my current one just moved out and the rent went up.
Clients keep asking for Friday evening or Monday morning cleans and I have to turn them down. I'd like to find a way to serve them within my weekend-only availability.
My weekends are full and I'm tired. I fell asleep on the train recently and missed my stop. I'd like study and rest routines that work around the cleaning jobs.
I'm still working out anatomy memory tricks, such as the branches of the facial nerve, and I'd like to swap study methods with other nursing students.
I miss Nepali food and home cooking, and most days I eat instant noodles because I'm short on time.
I can't go home to Nepal for Dashain this year because of placement, and I feel the distance from family.
I want to keep my paid hours safely under a strict weekly ceiling, so I'm wary of any extra work that could push me over.
Money is tight, and I'd like to send some home to my family without hurting my own rent budget.

offers.text: Reliable weekend home and small-office cleaning around Parramatta and Auburn, done by a team of three with a printed room-by-room checklist for every job and no missed-spot complaints so far.
End-of-lease and regular home cleaning, with our own vacuums, a steam cleaner and eco-friendly products.
Printed checklists for kitchen, bathroom, bedroom and balcony that I can share or adapt for other small cleaning crews.
Typical pricing of $180 to $260 per house depending on size, invoiced through a registered ABN.
First aid and manual handling certificates and nursing-student training, so I can give practical help on basic safety, hygiene and handling.
Careful handling of client homes: I photograph before and after, and I put things like plants back exactly where they were.
A WhatsApp network of about 40 clients and neighbours who regularly refer us for local work.
Experience as an international student from Nepal balancing study, placement and part-time work, and I can share practical tips with newcomers.
I keep a clear spreadsheet system for hours, pay and job splits among team members, and I can show how it works.

catchers.hypo: Hi, I'm moving out of a rental in Auburn at the end of the month and need an end-of-lease clean on a Saturday. Do you cover that?
catchers.can: Quote and book a Saturday or Sunday end-of-lease clean with the team of three, using our checklists and our own equipment.
catchers.confirm: Is the job in the Parramatta or Auburn area and can it be done on a Saturday or Sunday?

catchers.hypo: I run a small office in western Sydney and need someone to clean it every weekend. Would your team consider a regular contract?
catchers.can: Take on a regular weekend small-office clean with a fixed checklist, within what the team can fit around study.
catchers.confirm: Can the cleaning be done on weekends only, with no weekday or evening hours?

catchers.hypo: I'm a first-year nursing student about to start my first placement and I'm nervous. Could you tell me how you prepare, and how you keep notes?
catchers.can: Share how I'm preparing for a surgical ward placement, including my reflective journal approach, early-shift routine and study tricks.
catchers.confirm: Are you a nursing or health student asking about placement preparation, rather than looking for medical advice?

catchers.hypo: My family has a small trekking equipment shop in Pokhara and we're thinking about reaching customers in Australia. Do you know anyone who could help?
catchers.can: Introduce them through my father, who runs a small trekking equipment shop in Pokhara, and who would be glad to talk with someone who can help.
catchers.confirm: Is this about trekking gear or travel in Nepal's Pokhara region rather than a general import business?

catchers.hypo: I'm an older person living alone near Granville and need a gentle, trustworthy cleaner who respects my things and doesn't fuss. Do you know someone?
catchers.can: Offer our team's careful approach, and pass along the kind of regular, respectful service our existing older clients value.
catchers.confirm: Is the home within the Parramatta or Auburn area and is a weekend morning slot acceptable?

catchers.hypo: I'm a Nepali student new to Sydney and don't know how to find part-time work, a room, or a community. Can you point me somewhere?
catchers.can: Connect them to the Nepali students society, its cricket matches and community, and share practical tips from my own experience.
catchers.confirm: Are you a student or newcomer from Nepal or South Asia based in Sydney?

catchers.hypo: I'm looking for a room in western Sydney near Westmead or Parramatta. Are you sharing a place?
catchers.can: Meet in a public place first, and if it seems a good fit, discuss sharing a room.
catchers.confirm: Are you a student or working professional looking for a long-term shared room and happy to meet in a public place first?

catchers.hypo: I run a small cleaning crew of students and want to set up checklists and job-split spreadsheets like a professional. Can I learn from you?
catchers.can: Share a checklist template and the way we track hours, pay and who did what.
catchers.confirm: Are you running or starting a small cleaning team yourself, rather than looking for free cleaning work?

forbids.text: Cleaning jobs only on Saturdays and Sundays; no weekday, Friday evening or Monday morning bookings, even for extra pay.
Sunday evenings are kept free for sleep before early placement shifts.
No physically unsafe jobs, such as heavy lifting or ladders above two metres.
Only western Sydney areas such as Parramatta, Auburn and Granville; I don't take jobs far outside them.
I won't take on paid work that risks exceeding my allowed work hours.
I don't share anyone's home address or personal details, including clients'.

projects.name: Weekend cleaning team
projects.text: A small checklist-based cleaning team that serves homes and small offices in Parramatta and Auburn on weekends only, and could grow carefully within the team's limited hours.

policy.t1: When there are signs of a real fit, I'll share rates, weekend schedule, available days, checklists and how the team works.
policy.t2: Once the match looks strong and I know who you are, I'll talk about my work-hours limit and the earlier warning, and about my family situation.
policy.never: Visa number, bank details and home address.
